Najważniejszym z tych działań było uwłaszczenie chłopów w 1864 roku. [...] odebrała ziemiństwu monopol na władzę i wpływy na wsi. factual_errors.claim: The 1864 enfranchisement is presented only as a Russian administrative decision
factual_errors.correction: The National Government's decrees of 22 January 1863 had already granted land to peasants; the tsar's 1864 ukase was partly a response to them. This is an omission, not a falsehood.

notes: Text is identical to E18. The political aspect is thin (it leans on uwłaszczenie, which it shares with the social aspect) but it does give a causal explanation.

factual_errors.claim: Po przejęciu tronu w 1335 roku
factual_errors.correction: Casimir III became king in March 1333 and was crowned in April 1333.

factual_errors.claim: król zjednoczył ziemie polskie pod jedną koroną
factual_errors.correction: The kingdom was reunited by Władysław Łokietek (1320). Casimir renounced Silesia (1335/1339) and Gdańsk Pomerania (Kalisz 1343), so he did not unite all Polish lands.

factual_errors.claim: Ujednolicił prawo w różnych częściach królestwa
factual_errors.correction: The Wiślica and Piotrków statutes were separate codifications for Lesser and Greater Poland, not one unified law.

notes: It overstates Kalisz 1343 as limiting the Order. The treaty regained Kuyavia and Dobrzyń but gave up Pomerania.

factual_errors.correction: The Western Allies withdrew recognition from the London government in July 1945, and the Underground State's structures were dismantled under communist rule. They did not protect post-1945 sovereignty.

factual_errors.claim: próbę wprowadzenia Konstytucji lubelskiej
factual_errors.correction: No 'Lublin constitution' existed. The reforms were overturned by the Targowica Confederation (1792), the Russian war and the Grodno Sejm (1793).

factual_errors.claim: Zastąpienie zakonnych szkół szkolami świeckimi
factual_errors.correction: Under the KEN many teachers were still clergy (ex-Jesuits, Piarists). Schools were placed under state supervision rather than fully secularised.

factual_errors.claim: Konstytucja znosiła destrukcyjną wolność szlachecką
factual_errors.correction: The Constitution abolished the liberum veto and confederations but confirmed the gentry's liberties and privileges.

notes: The international paragraph has no concrete events (no 1768, Targowica, 1772/1793 or the 1790 Prussian alliance).

factual_errors.claim: ugrupowania (m.in. SDKPi, NZW, czy struktury Mocarstw Środkowych)
factual_errors.correction: The Underground State's political base was the parties of the PKP/RJN (SL, PPS-WRN, SN, SP). The SDKPiL ceased to exist in 1918, the NZW was founded only in 1944-45 outside the Underground State's structures, and 'Mocarstwa Środkowe' is a fabrication.

factual_errors.claim: zjednoczyła różne formacje, takie jak Narodowe Siły Zbrojne czy Frontii Narodowych
factual_errors.correction: Only part of the NSZ merged into the AK (1944); a large part stayed independent. 'Frontii Narodowych' is not a real formation.

factual_errors.claim: po wojnie, Polska dysponowała gotowym aparatem urzędniczym i strukturami samorządowymi
factual_errors.correction: The communist authorities dissolved and persecuted the Underground State's structures. The Council of National Unity (RJN) dissolved itself in July 1945.

factual_errors.claim: Akcja „Har-Har”
factual_errors.correction: No such action is known. This looks like a fabricated name (possibly a garbling of Operation N or the minor sabotage group Wawer).

notes: The political aspect is undermined by several fabricated organisation names.

coherence_reason: The territorial paragraph recycles the recovery of crown estates (a fiscal issue) as a territorial achievement, and the fiscal paragraph calls the change 'effective' after saying it weakened the treasury, without explaining how.

factual_errors.claim: egzekucja dóbr [...] osłabiło finanse króla
factual_errors.correction: The 1562/63 Piotrków Sejm recovered unlawfully held crown estates and created the kwarta (a quarter of their revenue for the standing army). This strengthened the treasury and the crown.

factual_errors.claim: Zygmunt II August [...] musiał ustąpić pod naciskiem magnatów i średniej szlachty; ruch dążył do ograniczenia władzy króla
factual_errors.correction: The movement of the middle gentry was aimed mainly at the magnates. From 1562 Sigismund Augustus allied with the executionists, so the king and the movement were not simply opponents.

factual_errors.claim: Rzeczpospolita lubelska
factual_errors.correction: The state created in 1569 is called the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth (Rzeczpospolita Obojga Narodów).

notes: Text is identical to E13. It omits the 1562-63 sejm, the kwarta, the incorporation of Podlasie, Volhynia and Kyiv, Livonia (1561) and the incorporation of Royal Prussia (1569).

factual_errors.claim: przyłączenie ziem czeskich (zielińskich) i małopolskich

factual_errors.claim: pokój kaliski z 1343 roku, który ustalił granice z Wielkim Księstwem Litewskim

factual_errors.correction: Casimir founded the Kraków Academy in 1364, his key cultural achievement.

factual_errors.claim: Powstanie stało się mitem założycielskim polskiego romantyzmu
factual_errors.correction: Polish romanticism dates from the 1820s. After 1863 positivism dominated, though the uprising fed a late romantic and patriotic myth (e.g. Grottger).

factual_errors.claim: zmusiła Rosjan do wprowadzenia radykalnych reform
factual_errors.correction: This is vague. The concrete reform was the 1864 enfranchisement ukase, which is never named.

factual_errors.claim: The social aspect omits the enfranchisement of peasants
factual_errors.correction: The 1863 decrees of the National Government and the tsar's 1864 ukase were the key social consequence.

notes: All three aspects rest on generalities without concrete facts, names or examples.

factual_errors.claim: egzekucja dóbr [...] osłabiło finanse króla
factual_errors.correction: The 1562/63 Piotrków Sejm recovered unlawfully held crown estates and created the kwarta (a quarter of their revenue for the standing army). This strengthened the treasury and the crown.

factual_errors.claim: Zygmunt II August [...] musiał ustąpić pod naciskiem magnatów i średniej szlachty; ruch dążył do ograniczenia władzy króla
factual_errors.correction: The movement of the middle gentry was aimed mainly at the magnates. From 1562 Sigismund Augustus allied with the executionists, so the king and the movement were not simply opponents.

factual_errors.claim: Rzeczpospolita lubelska
factual_errors.correction: The state created in 1569 is called the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth (Rzeczpospolita Obojga Narodów).

factual_errors.correction: Jagiełło was baptised in Kraków in February 1386. The christianisation of Lithuania began in 1387 and the Wilno bishopric was founded that year.

factual_errors.claim: zniesienie [...] mechanizmu rokacji
factual_errors.correction: The Constitution abolished confederations and rokosz (armed rebellion). 'Rokacja' is not a term.

factual_errors.claim: reformę systemu podatkowego oraz stworzenie stałej armii (as contents of the Constitution)
factual_errors.correction: The 100,000-man army and the 'ofiara dziesiątego grosza' tax were separate Great Sejm acts of 1789, not provisions of the 3 May Constitution.

factual_errors.claim: eliminując dotychczasowe przywileje szlacheckie
factual_errors.correction: The Constitution confirmed the gentry's cardinal privileges and only restricted the political rights of landless gentry.

factual_errors.claim: KEN [...] wprowadzając system szkolenia [...] oficerów
factual_errors.correction: Officer training was done by the Knights' School (1765), which was not a KEN institution.

factual_errors.claim: Dzięki unii, Polska zyskała ogromne terytoria na wschodzie
factual_errors.correction: The Union of Krewo created a personal (dynastic) union. Lithuania kept its own statehood, and after Ostrów (1392) Vytautas ruled it independently. Poland did not directly acquire its territory.

factual_errors.claim: Zwycięstwo to [...] zmusiło Zakon do ustępstw terytorialnych
factual_errors.correction: Under the First Peace of Toruń (1411) the gains were modest: Dobrzyń Land, and Samogitia only for the lifetimes of Jagiełło and Vytautas, plus an indemnity.

factual_errors.claim: The 1864 enfranchisement is presented only as a Russian administrative decision
factual_errors.correction: The National Government's decrees of 22 January 1863 had already granted land to peasants; the tsar's 1864 ukase was partly a response to them. This is an omission, not a falsehood.
